remarks: This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence is located in the highly sought-after Eastside Commons and features 9-foot ceilings, expansive sunlit windows, and a bright open-concept layout. The spacious living area offers direct access to a private balcony, which is also accessible from the primary bedroom, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The kitchen welcomes you upon entry with granite countertops, a large island, and ample cabinetry, providing both functionality and style. The primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet and a well-appointed en suite bathroom, while the second bedroom also features a walk-in closet and is conveniently located across from a full hallway bathroom. Additional highlights include a full-size washer and dryer for everyday convenience. Residents enjoy access to a fitness center, a beautifully maintained courtyard with gas grills and seating, and garage parking with two elevator access points. Ideally situated near I-95, downtown Stamford, and the Stamford Metro-North/Amtrak station, the location offers easy access to transportation, shopping, dining, and entertainment. The unit includes one assigned covered garage space along with an additional unassigned parking space.
